cards.title: Validation of MRT via Dose Elimination and Area Attainment
cards.claim: The validity of the proposed MRT calculation method is assessed by examining the percentage of administered dose eliminated and the percentage of total area attained at the calculated MRT compared to the moment theory result (AUMC/AUC).
conditions: Validation of nonlinear PK parameter estimation methods.
Assessment of how well the calculated MRT represents the actual disposition characteristics.
required_inputs: Time-concentration data to calculate cumulative dose eliminated.
Time-concentration data to calculate cumulative area attained.
limitations: Abstract does not provide the specific percentage thresholds for acceptance.
Does not specify if this validation applies to single-dose or multiple-dose scenarios explicitly, though 'single dose' is mentioned in related article titles in the metadata.
cards.downstream_use: Use this conceptual framework to validate nonlinear PK models. If the calculated MRT does not correspond to a logical percentage of dose eliminated or area attained, the model or parameter estimation may be flawed.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
